_note: Frozen MCP tool contract: the 63 tool names, descriptions and inputSchema values this server must keep serving. Changing a name, a description or a schema here is a client visible contract change, so this file is never hand edited: regenerate it deliberately with the command below and review the diff.

tools.name: admin.add_member
tools.description: Add a person to a project (owner or platform admin).

project_id.description: Id of the project to add the member to.

person.description: Person id to add as a member.

tools.name: admin.create_project
tools.description: Create a project for a designated owner and provision its volume (platform admin only).

project_id.description: New project id: 3 to 32 chars, lowercase letters, digits, hyphens, alphanumeric bounds.

owner.description: Person id who owns the new project.

tools.name: admin.delete_project
tools.description: Delete a project and recursively tear down its volume (owner or platform admin).

project_id.description: Id of the project to delete.

tools.name: admin.get_index_mode
tools.description: Get the current search index mode for a project (member or platform admin).

project_id.description: Id of the project whose search index mode is read.

tools.name: admin.list_all_projects
tools.description: List every project (platform admin only).

tools.name: admin.list_members
tools.description: List members of a project (member or platform admin).

project_id.description: Id of the project whose members are listed.

tools.name: admin.list_projects
tools.description: List projects the caller can access.

tools.name: admin.list_users
tools.description: List every known person and platform admins (platform admin only).

tools.name: admin.remove_member
tools.description: Remove a person from a project (owner or platform admin).

project_id.description: Id of the project to remove the member from.

person.description: Person id to remove from the project.

tools.name: admin.set_index_mode
tools.description: Set the search index mode for a project (owner or platform admin). none=no index, bm25=full-text only, rag=vector only, both=full-text and vector. Switching to an active mode triggers an initial full index of existing files in the background. Switching to none wipes the index immediately.

project_id.description: Id of the project whose search index mode is set.

mode.description: New index mode: none, bm25, rag, or both. rag and both need a configured embedding endpoint. Any change to a different mode wipes the current index before rebuilding it, so setting the mode a project already has is a no-op that keeps the index intact.

tools.description: Recent mutations performed in this session.

since.description: Only return entries at or after this Unix timestamp (seconds).

limit.description: Maximum number of recent entries to return.

tools.description: Copy a file or tree (no-clobber by default).

overwrite.description: Allow overwriting an existing destination (default no-clobber).

tools.description: Count lines without returning content.

tools.description: Create an empty file (touch).

exist_ok.description: Succeed silently if the file already exists.

tools.description: Delete a path (moves to trash by default).

recursive.description: Required to delete a non-empty directory.

tools.name: fs.documentize
tools.description: Generate the Markdown companion of a stored document.

path.description: Absolute POSIX path of the stored document to convert. PowerPoint, Word, PDF, audio and video only.

tools.name: fs.edit
tools.description: Replace a unique string; dry_run returns the diff.

path.description: Absolute POSIX path within the volume.

old_string.description: Exact text to find; must be unique unless replace_all is set.

replace_all.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match.

dry_run.description: Return the diff without writing changes.

tools.name: fs.exists
tools.description: Probe whether a path exists and its kind.

tools.name: fs.extract_text
tools.description: Extract a document to Markdown and store it as a companion .md next to the source (report.pdf -> report.md), reusing it if already up to date. Returns md_path + a preview; read the .md with fs.read for the full content. Handles PDF, DOCX, PPTX, XLSX, HTML, CSV, images (OCR via a configured multimodal provider) and text; audio/video unsupported.

path.description: Absolute POSIX path of the source document.

max_chars.description: Maximum characters of Markdown to store.

preview_chars.description: Number of leading characters returned as a preview.

ocr.description: Enable OCR for images via a configured multimodal provider.

refresh.description: Force re-extraction even if the companion .md is up to date.

tools.name: git.remote_clone
tools.description: Clone a remote git repository (GitHub, GitLab, or any HTTPS URL) into a volume. Uses the OAuth token stored by git.auth if available for the detected provider. Copies all files into the volume AND imports the full git history into the git backend. Use depth=1 for a shallow clone (faster on large repos).

mount_id.description: Project/volume id the clone is imported into.

url.description: Remote git repository URL (GitHub, GitLab, or any HTTPS URL).

branch.description: Branch to clone; omit to use the remote default branch.

depth.description: Shallow clone depth; 0 clones the full history.

tools.name: git.remote_fetch
tools.description: Fetch objects and update refs/remotes/origin/* from origin. Never advances a local branch and never touches a working tree file. A branch removed on the remote is reported in refs_stale, not pruned locally.

tools.name: git.remote_pull
tools.description: Fetch from origin, then advance the checked-out branch to the remote tip and update the volume's files to match. A fast-forward applies directly. A diverged history is refused unless on_conflict is 'ours' or 'theirs', in which case a three-way merge resolves every conflicting file by that strategy and creates a merge commit. Refuses a dirty volume (commit or discard first) and refuses any branch other than the one currently checked out.

branch.description: Branch to pull; must be the branch currently checked out.

on_conflict.description: For a diverged (non fast-forward) history: 'ours' or 'theirs' to resolve every conflicting file by that strategy and create a merge commit; omit to refuse the pull instead. Ignored whenever the pull is a fast-forward.

tools.name: git.remote_push
tools.description: Push a local branch to origin under the same name. Creates the branch on the remote when it is absent there. Fails if the push is not a fast-forward; force is not supported.

branch.description: Local branch to push to origin under the same name.

tools.name: git.show
tools.description: Show details and diff of a commit.

commit_sha.description: Commit SHA to show details and diff for.

tools.name: git.status
tools.description: Show HEAD, current branch, and all refs.

tools.name: git.tags
tools.description: List all tags.

tools.name: git.token_set
tools.description: Seed a personal access token you already hold for a host declared in git.hosts, without the interactive device flow. The token is never echoed back.

host.description: Hostname declared in git.hosts to store the token for.

token.description: The personal access token value. Never echoed back; 1 to 8192 characters.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp the token expires at; omit or null for a token that never expires.
